# American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD)

> The American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry is the professional organization for pediatric dentists, offering membership, continuing education, practice resources, and advocacy for children's oral health.

AAPD serves pediatric dental professionals with comprehensive member resources, educational programs including an annual Las Vegas conference, residency training information, and practice management tools. The organization also provides public oral health information through MyChildrensTeeth.org and maintains partnerships with accreditation bodies like the Commission on Dental Accreditation.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry

## Membership & Organization

- [Join AAPD](https://www.aapd.org/about/about-aapd/membership-join): AAPD membership application and categories for pediatric dentistry professionals
- [About AAPD](https://www.aapd.org/about/about-aapd): Organization overview of American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry mission and vision
- [Member Resources](https://www.aapd.org/resources/member): Member resources including dues, governance, awards, and practice management
- [States and Districts](https://www.aapd.org/about/state-and-district-chapters): AAPD state and district chapter leadership and organizational structure
- [Self Service Portal](https://online.aapd.org/aapdssa/censsacustmast.insert_page): AAPD Self Service Portal for member account and profile management

## Education & Professional Development

- [Education Homepage](https://www.aapd.org/education/education-homepage): Continuing education, annual conference in Las Vegas, and professional development
- [Residency Programs](https://www.aapd.org/resources/member/resident-resources/residency-programs): Residency program information, interview dates, and dental education resources
- [Career Center](https://jobs.aapd.org): AAPD Career Center job board for pediatric dentistry positions

## Practice Resources & Guidelines

- [Resources Overview](https://www.aapd.org/resources/resources): Comprehensive resources for members and parents on pediatric dental care
- [Practice Checklist Resources](https://www.aapd.org/about/about-aapd/news-room/aapd-practice-checklist-resources): Practice safety checklists and infection control resources for dental offices
